# Public Assets

## Avatar
Place your profile photo at: `public/avatar.jpg`

## Certificates
Place certificate images in `public/certs/`:
- `public/certs/simplilearn.jpg`     ← Simplilearn Certificate
- `public/certs/google.jpg`          ← Google Cybersecurity (if adding)
- `public/certs/cisco.jpg`           ← Cisco Networking (if adding)
- `public/certs/codsoft-offer.jpg`   ← CodSoft Offer Letter (if adding)

Update the `img` path in `src/routes/index.tsx` → `certifications` array.

## Image formats
JPG, PNG, or WebP all work fine.
